emily: quick sync 18:00-20:00 PT window. plan: Py SDK 1.5.0 + TS SDK 2.0.0. small canary then ramp.
emily: TS is async-first; py will deprecate the sync client with warnings for two minors. canary cadence: 5% -> 25% -> GA. need rollback criteria, dedicated fallback pin, and release notes owner. @sam @jia please ack. :eyes: 
sam: ack. i'll run deploy-bot. paste exact publish commands + dist-tag plan pls.
emia: (typo) meant emily: commands below.
emily: ```
Py: python -m build && twine upload dist/*  # publishes 1.5.0 to pypi
TS: npm publish packages/sdk --access public && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 next
Policy: 'next' = canary; move 'latest' -> 2.0.0 after GA. deprecate package `redwood-sync` after py GA.
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued (1740539999-canary): python:1.5.0@5%, ts:2.0.0@5%. ETA +4m.
jia: quick staging smoke for TS 2.0.0 shows a sync shim regression: "TypeError: client.request is not a function" at lib/index.js:40. patch in PR but needs review.
sam: hold TS canary. initiating rollback for ts-only canary id 1740539999-canary-ts.
sam: deploy-bot, run: rollback 1740539999-canary-ts and set npm dist-tag back to 1.9.4
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for 1740539999-canary-ts. removing 2.0.0 from 'next' and reassigning 1.9.4. status: in-progress.
sam: commands used: ```
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.4 next
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk 2.0.0 || true
```
emily: OK TS paused. proceeding with Py canary if ops can pin a Dedicated fallback and keep redwood-sync package available until we GA.
ops: pinned fallback: redwood@1.4.12 -> "fallback" pool (TTL 48h). API: curl -X POST https://internal.ops/api/pins -d '{"package":"redwood","version":"1.4.12","pool":"fallback","ttl":"48h"}'
ops: also uploaded a small script to reassign dist-tags and an ops playbook.
harry: i'll write release notes and changelog. draft PR incoming; will call out TS delay and deprecation timeline.
emily: rollback triggers (agreed):
 - token-level error rate > 1.8% sustained 10m (baseline <0.5%)
 - any production canary smoke/e2e fail (auth/connect/streaming)
 - artifact checksum or signature mismatch on published package
 - auth regressions impacting >1% of tokens
emily: monitoring request: wire token-level p50+p95 and error-rate alerts. threshold: >1.8% errors OR p95 +40ms delta -> page. @ops @jia
ops: alerts wired. playbook action: flip feature flag, unassign 'next' tag, and repin fallback pool. script: ops/release/reassign-tag.sh in repo.
sam: final plan: proceed with Py canary at 5% now, monitor 30m, then 25% if green. TS GA postponed until PR lands and a follow-up canary passes.
emily: action owners: sam (deploy), jia (ts fix + tests), ops (pin/alerts/script), harry (notes).
emily: note: if rollback triggers fire, run the playbook, ping #eng-oncall and #devex, and execute npm unpublish/unassign steps.
harry: noted. drafting markdown for the deprecation section and include migration examples (openSession() -> connect()).
emia: (typo) meant emily: :white_check_mark: starting Py canary. will paste deploy-bot confirmation when it begins.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Py canary started (1740539999-canary-py) at 5% traffic. monitoring window 30m.
